title: open-gsd/gsd-core
why_good: An opinionated 'git → ship' workflow wrapper — but 'Core' with a vague pitch means the actual wedge isn't clear yet.
value: Only monetizable if it becomes a team CI/release layer people standardize on; as a solo git helper it's hard to charge for.
risk: Crowded with git-workflow tools; no obvious moat or buyer yet, and the value prop is still fuzzy.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product that improves Git operations, which can be monetized through subscriptions or enterprise licensing.

zh.claim: open-gsd/gsd-core —— Git. Ship. Done(提交·发布·搞定)的核心。
zh.why_good: 一个有主见的「git → 发布」流程封装——但叫「Core」又定位模糊,真正的切口还不清晰。
zh.value: 只有变成团队愿意统一的 CI/发布层才好收费;当个人 git 助手很难要钱。
zh.risk: git 工作流工具很挤;还没有明显护城河或买家,价值主张也还含糊。
zh.hook: 被 vibe-coding 漂移淹没的 Claude Code 重度用户——157 位贡献者正在自己动手建规格化护栏。
zh.does: 面向编码 agent（Claude Code、Kimi CLI、Qoder）的规格驱动开发流程：代码落地前先过 plan → spec → verify 门。亮点：30 天 746 次提交，外部贡献者主动添加新运行时支持。
zh.gap: 没有留给你的缺口——社区自己在补自己的坑。它是『规格门正在成为常态』的能力信号，不是机会。
zh.counter: 免费、社区共有的方法论层：没有买单方，且 Anthropic 或各运行时随时可以原生吸收这套流程。
zh.differentiator: 作为生意没有切入口。值得盯的是它的用户还在抱怨什么——『agent 真按我的意思做了』的非开发者侧还没有产品。

hook: Claude Code power users drowning in vibe-code drift — 157 contributors are building the spec-driven guardrails themselves.
does: Spec-driven development workflow for coding agents (Claude Code, Kimi CLI, Qoder): plan → spec → verify gates before code lands. Standout: 746 commits/30d with external contributors adding new agent runtimes unprompted.
gap: None open to you — the community is closing its own gaps. This is a capability signal that spec-gates are becoming the norm, not an opportunity.
counter: A free, community-owned methodology layer: there is no buyer, and Anthropic or the runtimes can absorb the workflow natively at any point.
differentiator: None as a business. Worth watching what its users still complain about — the non-developer side of 'the agent did what I meant' has no product yet.
